nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Nova! The Reach has been waiting for someone willing to follow its scattered light. Ember Shards mark the safest rhythm forward.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: What would you like to ask?

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Old paths remember patient feet. Look above the obvious road, and listen when the embers hum.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: May your next step find solid ground.
